text.en:
Availability of Appropriations. - The appropriations for MOOE
and capital outlays in the FY 2010 GAA shall be available for release and obligation
for the purpose specified thereunder and with the same special and general provisions
applicable thereto for a period extending December 31, 2011.
58180
POMA Hologram: 58180

Effectivity. - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 28th day of June
Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
_, in the Year of Our
GLORIA MACAPAGAL ARROYO
By Authority of the President:
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 58181
